name: ghidra
description: Installs Ghidra plus the GhidraMCP stack: extension (headless auto-enabled), MCP bridge via uv tool (/usr/local/bin/bridge-mcp-ghidra), and PyGhidra enrollment. URL resolved via the GitHub releases API.

version.description: Select Ghidra version (release tags look like Ghidra_12.2_build); 'none' skips installation.

mcpServer.description: MCP server stack: ghidramcp = bethington fork (extension + uv-installed bridge, HTTP :8089); ghidrassist = GhidrAssistMCP native extension (HTTP :8080, no bridge).
